topic: Pappu teaches Chacha Jee to make a short video, and it goes viral for the wrong reason.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ki Viral Safai!

shots.narration: چچا کی پہلی ویڈیو چلی، مگر ہیرو بنا جھاڑو!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani living room, sunny yellow walls, vertical 9:16, polished 3D animated comedy look, no text or lettering.
shots.action: Chacha confidently poses with a straw broom held like a film award.
shots.mood: Puffed chest, proud grin, comically glamorous sunlight.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، بس یہ گول بٹن دبائیں، ویڈیو شروع!
shots.scene: Same living room beside a small wooden table, phone screen showing only a large red circle, no text or lettering, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Pappu points to the phone's red recording button while Chacha watches.
shots.mood: Patient young teacher, overly confident uncle, warm sunny colours.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، اداکاری تو میرے بائیں ہاتھ کا کھیل!
shots.scene: Living room with a phone mounted vertically on a plain tripod, no text or lettering, bright 3D animation, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha strikes a grand moustache-twirling pose in front of the phone.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, theatrical confidence, Pappu's patient smile.

shots.narration: چاچی آئیں، پہلے کمرہ صاف کریں، پھر ہیرو بنیں!
shots.scene: Same living room with scattered crumbs on the tiled floor and the recording phone in the foreground, no text, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chachi hands Chacha the straw broom.
shots.mood: Chachi's firm smile, Chacha's suddenly drooping moustache.

shots.narration: چچا نے صفائی کو بھی فلمی منظر بنا ڈالا!
shots.scene: Sunlit living room floor with crumbs, recording phone visible at the frame edge, no text or lettering, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha sweeps the crumbs with an exaggerated dancing flourish.
shots.mood: Energetic slapstick, billowing waistcoat, delighted theatrical expression.

shots.narration: پپو ہنسا، چچا، کیمرا تو ابھی تک چل رہا تھا!
shots.scene: Beside the tripod in the same living room, phone showing a plain red recording circle without words or numbers, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Pappu points at the still-recording phone beside a frozen, broom-holding Chacha.
shots.mood: Pappu's amused smile, Chacha's wide-eyed surprise.

shots.narration: ویڈیو لگائی، تو دل والے نشان برسنے لگے!
shots.scene: Living room sofa, close view of a phone displaying Chacha's broom dance surrounded by numerous heart icons, no words or numbers, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Pappu holds the phone up for Chacha to see.
shots.mood: Pappu's delighted grin, Chacha's returning celebrity swagger.

shots.narration: چاچی بولیں، اداکاری نہیں، آپ کی صفائی مشہور ہوئی!
shots.scene: Same living room, phone screen visibly displaying the broom dance with heart icons only, clean tiled floor, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chachi points at the broom in Chacha's hands.
shots.mood: Chachi's victorious knowing smile, Chacha's deflated pride, Pappu's suppressed l

shots.narration: مشہور صفائی والے، اب کپڑے دھوئیں؛ اگلی ویڈیو تیار ہے!
shots.scene: Sunny laundry corner adjoining the living room, plain washing machine without labels, Pappu beside the phone tripod, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chachi places an overflowing laundry basket into Chacha's arms.
shots.mood: Chachi's triumphant grin, Chacha's stunned face above the laundry, Pappu's eager

episode.endHook: Agli video mein Chacha Jee ka washing machine se muqabla!
episode.description: پپو نے چچا جی کو مختصر ویڈیو بنانا سکھائی، مگر مشہور کچھ اور ہی ہوگیا۔ چچا جی کی اداکاری اپنی جگہ، چاچی جان نے اصل کام نکلوا لیا!
